images.decisionImpact: Role, anatomy, fluid digit scale, column gap and 1.9ch minimum measure already match the design system; the readable date is an outside element (deadlineText), and the digit row is aria-hidden (a divergence the DS does not adopt).

notCaptured.reason: The web page has no placeholder, expired or unavailable state: its tick clamps at zero and rewrites the label. There is nothing to capture for that branch, and the design-system states come from its own approved contract, not from the source.

The live branch renders only on a Wednesday between 18:00 and 20:00 Europe/Madrid. VIS-05 reaches it with a frozen browser clock instead of waiting for that window; the alternative (editing the schedule) would have modified the source.
This version is documentation only; the current implementation is not approved expected design and captured implementation would add no evidence for the mapping decision.

limits: The captures show the web's local .cd styles and Spanish copy. They are evidence for the role and the mapping, not approved expected design for the Countdown recipe.
pulso-source.html is a template with Jinja image placeholders; no placeholder image is inside these crops.
The reveal system starts every [data-reveal] node at opacity 0; the script forces the revealed state so the crops are not pre-reveal captures. No source file is modified.

In the /tmp harness document.fonts.check('600 13px Barlow') returned false while the condensed 600 check returned true; only the small .meta captions on the VIS-06 board use the sans family, and the countdown text itself is condensed and unaffected.
VIS-03/VIS-05 record live JavaScript state (a real remaining time and a frozen elapsed time), so the digits are a moment of a ticking readout, not a fixed design value.
Browser images do not verify behaviour, accessibility, keyboard or focus behaviour.

PNG bytes can differ between runs of the same script (scroll-dependent compositing); the hashes above are of the files stored in this folder and must be re-verified with sha256sum before linking them in any published comment.
